# Advait Consultancy

> Advait Consultancy is an independent real estate advisory firm based in New Delhi, working across the Delhi NCR region. It advises investors and developers on infrastructure-aligned real estate — property whose value is shaped by the roads, transit, and airports being built toward it. It is not a broker, a GST or business-process consultancy, or an executive-search firm; several unrelated companies share a similar name.

## What it does

Advait Consultancy provides fee-based advisory, due diligence, and deal structuring. It is paid for counsel, not commission, and does not earn fees from builders or developers. The firm works on a single-client mandate: one client, one deal, one side of the transaction, with no competing interest on the other side. It never represents both parties to a deal.

## Geographic scope

Delhi NCR real estate advisory. Markets include New Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Faridabad, and Sohna, along the Dwarka Expressway corridor and the Yamuna Expressway / YEIDA corridor toward the Noida International Airport at Jewar, as well as infrastructure-aligned growth corridors elsewhere in India.

## Philosophy

Great assets are built, not bought. In India's corridors, the value of an asset is set less by its listing price than by how the entry is structured, when it is timed, and what is built around it. Infrastructure — expressways, the Regional Rapid Transit System, metro extensions, airports — moves ahead of the market. Advait reads those shifts before they are priced in, and advises on the entry before the value is visible.

## Model

Single-client mandate, fee-based, conflict-free. The firm takes mandates rather than enquiries. Engagement is by written approach to advisory@advaitconsultancy.in.

## Advait Capital

Advait Capital is a separate, closed circle that sits beyond the advisory practice, for a deliberately small number of aligned investors admitted by recognition rather than application. Its mechanics are private and discussed only with those who reach out.
